definitions.explanation: The official teachings or beliefs of a religion, philosophy, or ideology. The fundamental principles that adherents are expected to accept and follow.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教義|きょうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: To study the doctrine of that religion.

examples.japanese: {教義|きょうぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反|はん}する→反する：11966_hansuru⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されなかった→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: Acts that went against the doctrine were not permitted.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{宗派|しゅうは}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{教義|きょうぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}→解釈：02603_kaishaku⟧をめぐって⟦{分裂|ぶんれつ}→分裂：11747_bunretsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This sect has a history of splitting over the interpretation of doctrine.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily used in discussions of religion, theology, and philosophy. Can also be used metaphorically for rigid ideological principles. More formal and specific than ⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧ (teachings).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教義|きょうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to study doctrine
- {教義|きょうぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow doctrine
- {教義|きょうぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反|はん}する→反する：11966_hansuru⟧: to go against doctrine
- {教義|きょうぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}→解釈：02603_kaishaku⟧: interpretation of doctrine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{教|おし}え→教える：00526_oshieru⟧: teachings (general, less formal)
- ドグマ: dogma (loanword, often negative connotation)
- ⟦{信条|しんじょう}→信条：10451_shinjou⟧: creed, belief (personal conviction)
- ⟦{経典|きょうてん}→経典：24153_kyouten⟧: scripture, sacred text
